summary: Positions 0-151 (152 entries; sheets 00,01,04-18 opened, 02-03 not needed: all skips with no photo or design case). Haiku: 46 photo, 18 unsure, 88 skip. Of the 46 photo entries: 21 accepted as keep_ok (4 with fixes: naturbornholm concepts, museum-of-west-african-art features, museum-of-glass year 2002, phoenix-center year 2014), 2 are held for want of a good main photo (lucas-museum-of-narrative-art, suzhou-culture-and-arts-centre); zaryadye-concert-hall is kept but needs the 2026 photo first, and 23 are keep_wrong (mostly ordinary theatres, schools, civic and convention types with a lead that gives no design reason; the borderline ones are marked so they can come back). Rescued 3 of 106 unsure/skip: maritime-centre-vellamo, iki-city-ikikoku-museum (architect check: Kurokawa died 2007, built 2010, accepted as posthumous completion), bunker-599. Architect checks: Dubai Opera and Georgian Parliament stay out (no usable exterior photo); Jorge Oteiza Museum stays out (no clear exterior, Saenz de Oiza died 2000 but the design predates that); Ashdod stays skipped (lead names Haim Dotan, not Takamatsu; ordinary theatre, no design reason; if kept use Haim Dotan). Total accepted 24 (21 + 3 rescued); ordinary kept 4 (kiruna-city-hall, phoenix-center, fjordenhus, boekenberg) = 17%. Borderline skips an owner may want to see: residenze-libeskind (Libeskind housing, striking), nakanoshima-museum-of-art-osaka (black cube museum, architect not known abroad), kaohsiung-exhibition-center (Philip Cox convention centre), toyama-prefectural-museum-of-art-and-design (Naito; main photo not clearly the whole building). No wall duplicates found (no dup_flag in range, no matching qid, id or nearby building of the same name; zaryadye-concert-hall is separate from the wall's Zaryadye Park entry).
